exam_info.name: Professional Machine Learning Engineer
exam_info.description: A Professional Machine Learning Engineer builds, evaluates, productionizes, and optimizes AI solutions by using Google Cloud capabilities and knowledge of conventional ML approaches.

sections.name: Architecting low-code AI solutions
sections.description: Building AI solutions using low-code and no-code tools like BigQuery ML, AutoML, and foundation models

topics: Building appropriate BigQuery ML models (linear, binary classification, regression, time-series, matrix factorization, boosted trees, autoencoders)

topics: Building applications by using ML APIs from Model Garden
